records.summary: A loading button shows the spinner at its icon's size (simai/ui-source#10) -- sf-button, sf-icon-button and the buttons of sf-button-group, the segmented one included -- and the moving stripes are no longer the loading look. The Framework no longer sets --sf-button-loading-stripe or --sf-icon-button-loading-stripe; a page that sets either still gets still stripes in that colour over a loading button until remove_after, and nothing when it is unset.
records.manual: Delete the variable: a loading button shows the spinner, in the button's ink. To colour the spinner, set --sf-loader--color on the button or an ancestor.

records.summary: sf-button is served from smart/button/ since its folder took the tag's name (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §3, §21): js/button.js, loader bundle cl-button. The old path keeps working until remove_after: smart/buttons/js/buttons.js is a forwarding script that notes the path in SF.deprecations and loads smart/button/js/button.js, the Loader forwards the bundle name cl-buttons to cl-button (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json), and the registry id smart.buttons is a dated alias of smart.button, the id that follows the folder and the tag.
records.manual: Write smart/button/ for smart/buttons/ and button for buttons in the file names (js/button.js, js/button.min.js); in a product rule's relation write cl-button for cl-buttons, and in a manifest or a package contract smart.button for smart.buttons. A page that lets the Loader fetch sf-button needs no change.

records.summary: sf-tag is served from smart/tag/ since its folder took the tag's name (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §3, §21): js/tag.js and css/tag.css, loader bundle cl-tag. The old path keeps working until remove_after: smart/tags/js/tags.js is a forwarding script that notes the path in SF.deprecations and loads smart/tag/js/tag.js, smart/tags/css/tags.css is sf-tag's sheet, the Loader forwards the bundle name cl-tags to cl-tag (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json), and the registry id smart.tags is a dated alias of smart.tag, the id that follows the folder and the tag.
records.manual: Write smart/tag/ for smart/tags/ and tag for tags in the file names (js/tag.js, js/tag.min.js, css/tag.css, css/tag.min.css); in a product rule's relation write cl-tag for cl-tags, and in a manifest or a package contract smart.tag for smart.tags. A page that lets the Loader fetch sf-tag needs no change.
